title: The UI pass is a contract role beside the reviewer

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The UI pass exists only as rule u10 in a project matrix. The contract's Roles section has no UI pass, so every project re-describes it. In ork's run it caught layout problems the tests passed (S33 clipping at 80x24, S84 key width). ork decided adj 165 (`roles.ui-pass`) and built it into its engine (S117), and S121 makes it return renders (80x24, 120x40, ASCII) for the approval step. s392 adds only the ledger role name.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: Roles, Order and Every brief in both contract texts.
- The contract golden fixture; `docs/working-with-agents.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Name the UI pass: read-only, runs in parallel with the reviewer on a slice the project marks as UI, edits nothing, returns triaged suggestions (see the finding-kinds item) and, where the project can render, the changed views; the gate still decides. The project says what counts as a UI slice.
